about: Per-chip digital macro outline for the die-fit ledger (split phase 2): synthesized cell area of the chip configuration (verification/digital_hardening/synth_area.sh) scaled to the routed r8d macro (2.814 mm2 at 79.5 % utilisation) = the outline of verification/digital_hardening/<chip>/config.json. lb: the levers of the assignment (gated clocks, one read tree, 80 % utilisation: x 0.846 rf, x 0.869 wired).

rf.source: synthesized 1.053 mm2 of cells (0.766 x the both-halves build) -> outline 1716 x 1255.84 (verification/digital_hardening/rf/config.json); no place and route of this configuration yet
